three.bundle.js = three@0.170.0 + postprocessing addons (EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, BokehPass, ShaderPass, OutputPass, RoomEnvironment), bundled with esbuild as IIFE → window.THREE / window.THREEX.
